title: Actual completed quotient unit on a K-flat complex
statement: Let T,d be as in [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and let P be a complex which is K-flat for the actual completed coefficient ring. The actual reduction counit on its cochain localization is invertible. Via the canonical cochain localization bridges, compose the derived constant/limit-adjunction unit at Q(P), the derived inverse limit of the specified strict quotient augmentation, and the derived inverse limit of the universal reduction counit at P. The result equals Q of the ordinary constant/limit-adjunction unit at P, then Q of the ordinary inverse limit of the actual module quotient augmentation, then the universal comparison from ordinary inverse limit to total right derived inverse limit of the strict quotient complex of P.

source.place: current order 1316, Koszul-to-quotient comparison, including its unit equation

proof.text: Use the computation formula for the exact constant-functor/right-derived inverse-limit adjunction unit.

On P, the specified derived quotient augmentation followed by its universal reduction counit is the localization factorization of the ordinary quotient augmentation, by the defining K-flat normalization of that augmentation. The native K-flat computation makes this reduction counit invertible. The canonical cochain-localization bridges express both facts directly on complexes.

Apply derived inverse limit to this equation and use naturality of its universal comparison to move the ordinary quotient augmentation across it. Cancel the inverse localization-factorization isomorphisms and combine the two localized ordinary maps. This is the claimed identity.

theorem completedQuotientUnitNormalization
    (T : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (P : CochainComplex (reductionModules T (d.completedRing T)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := d.completedRing T) P) :
    letI := reductionModulesHasDerivedCategory T (d.completedRing T)
    letI := reductionTowerHasDerivedCategory T (reductionModuleRing T (d.completedRing T))
    let := completedReductionModuleTowerFunctor_additive T d
    let R := completedRlim T (d.completedRing T)
    let L := completedReductionModuleTowerFunctor T d
    let ε := derivedCochainCounit L (completedReductionTower T d)
      (completedReductionTowerCounit d T)
    let η := derivedCochainRightUnit (completedTowerLimit T (d.completedRing T)) R
      (completedRlimUnit T (d.completedRing T))
    IsIso (ε.app P) ∧
      (completedQuotientCompletionUnit T d).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          R.map (ε.app P) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (completedQuotientOrdinaryUnit T d P) ≫
          η.app ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
